041package paint.viewer.ui.layout;
042
043import paint.viewer.ui.panels.NavigationPanel;
044import paint.viewer.ui.panels.RecordingAttributesPanel;
045import paint.viewer.ui.panels.RecordingControlsPanel;
046import paint.viewer.ui.panels.SquareGridPanel;
047
048import javax.swing.*;
049import javax.swing.border.Border;
050import java.awt.*;
051
052import static paint.shared.constants.PaintGeometry.NUMBER_PIXELS_HEIGHT;
053import static paint.shared.constants.PaintGeometry.NUMBER_PIXELS_WIDTH;
054
055/**
056 * Builds the full layout structure for the ViewerFrame. All components required
057 * for UI updates (labels, grid panels, navigation, attributes, controls, etc.)
058 * are created here and returned in a {@link LayoutComponents} container.
059 */
060public class ViewerLayoutBuilder {
061
062    /**
063     * Listener for the viewer close event.
064     */
065    public interface CloseListener {
066        /**
067         * Called when the viewer should be closed.
068         */
069        void onClose();
070    }
071
072    /**
073     * Holds all top-level Swing components created by the layout builder.
074     * {@link paint.viewer.ui.frames.ViewerFrame} uses this object to update the
075     * UI during navigation.
076     */
077    public static class LayoutComponents {
078        /** The main root panel of the viewer. */
079        public final JPanel                   rootPanel;
080        /** Label displaying the right-side (reference) image. */
081        public final JLabel                   rightImageLabel;
082        /** Label displaying the current experiment name. */
083        public final JLabel                   experimentLabel;
084        /** Label displaying the current recording name. */
085        public final JLabel                   recordingLabel;
086        /** Panel containing the grid of squares. */
087        public final SquareGridPanel          leftGridPanel;
088        /** Panel displaying recording metadata attributes. */
089        public final RecordingAttributesPanel attributesPanel;
090        /** Panel containing navigation buttons. */
091        public final NavigationPanel          navigationPanel;
092        /** Panel containing interactive recording controls. */
093        public final RecordingControlsPanel   controlsPanel;
094        /** Checkbox for enabling override import. */
095        public final JCheckBox                importOverridesCheckBox;
096
097        /**
098         * Constructs a new {@code LayoutComponents} container.
099         *
100         * @param rootPanel               the root panel
101         * @param rightImageLabel         right image label
102         * @param experimentLabel         experiment label
103         * @param recordingLabel          recording label
104         * @param leftGridPanel           left grid panel
105         * @param attributesPanel         attributes panel
106         * @param navigationPanel         navigation panel
107         * @param controlsPanel           controls panel
108         * @param importOverridesCheckBox overrides checkbox
109         */
110        LayoutComponents(
111                JPanel                   rootPanel,
112                JLabel                   rightImageLabel,
113                JLabel                   experimentLabel,
114                JLabel                   recordingLabel,
115                SquareGridPanel          leftGridPanel,
116                RecordingAttributesPanel attributesPanel,
117                NavigationPanel          navigationPanel,
118                RecordingControlsPanel   controlsPanel,
119                JCheckBox                importOverridesCheckBox
120        ) {
121            this.rootPanel               = rootPanel;
122            this.rightImageLabel         = rightImageLabel;
123            this.experimentLabel         = experimentLabel;
124            this.recordingLabel          = recordingLabel;
125            this.leftGridPanel           = leftGridPanel;
126            this.attributesPanel         = attributesPanel;
127            this.navigationPanel         = navigationPanel;
128            this.controlsPanel           = controlsPanel;
129            this.importOverridesCheckBox = importOverridesCheckBox;
130        }
131    }
132
133    /**
134     * Creates the full viewer layout, assembles all Swing components into a
135     * top-level root panel, and returns the complete set of components that
136     * ViewerFrame will retain and update during interaction.
137     *
138     * @param gridDim             dimension of the square grid (gridDim × gridDim)
139     * @param navigationListener  listener for previous/next recording navigation
140     * @param recordingsControlListener    listener for recording-specific control actions
141     * @param closeListener       callback for closing the viewer
142     * @return a {@link LayoutComponents} instance containing all UI components
143     */
144    public LayoutComponents build(
145            int                                              gridDim,
146            NavigationPanel.Listener                         navigationListener,
147            RecordingControlsPanel.RecordingsControlListener recordingsControlListener,
148            CloseListener                                    closeListener) {
149
150        // --- Components created here so ViewerFrame never constructs them itself ---
151        JLabel rightImageLabel = new JLabel("", SwingConstants.CENTER);
152        JLabel experimentLabel = new JLabel("", SwingConstants.CENTER);
153        JLabel recordingLabel  = new JLabel("", SwingConstants.CENTER);
154
155        SquareGridPanel          leftGridPanel   = new SquareGridPanel(gridDim, gridDim);
156        RecordingAttributesPanel attributesPanel = new RecordingAttributesPanel();
157        NavigationPanel          navigationPanel = new NavigationPanel(navigationListener);
158        RecordingControlsPanel   controlsPanel   = new RecordingControlsPanel(recordingsControlListener);
159
160        // --- Image panels side-by-side (left grid + right image) ---
161        JPanel imagesInner = new JPanel(new GridLayout(1, 2, 15, 0));
162        imagesInner.add(createSquareImagePanel(leftGridPanel));
163        imagesInner.add(createSquareImagePanel(rightImageLabel));
164
165        // --- Labels panel (Experiment + Recording) ---
166        JPanel labelsPanel = new JPanel(new GridLayout(2, 1));
167        labelsPanel.setBorder(BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(5, 5, 5, 5));
168
169        experimentLabel.setFont(new Font("SansSerif", Font.BOLD, 13));
170        recordingLabel.setFont(new Font("SansSerif", Font.PLAIN, 12));
171
172        labelsPanel.add(experimentLabel);
173        labelsPanel.add(recordingLabel);
174
175        // --- Main image area with navigation ---
176        JPanel imagesWithNav = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(15, 15));
177        Border outer         = BorderFactory.createLineBorder(Color.DARK_GRAY, 2);
178        Border inner         = BorderFactory.createEmptyBorder(15, 15, 15, 15);
179        imagesWithNav.setBorder(BorderFactory.createCompoundBorder(outer, inner));
180
181        imagesWithNav.add(navigationPanel.getComponent(), BorderLayout.NORTH);
182        imagesWithNav.add(imagesInner,                    BorderLayout.CENTER);
183        imagesWithNav.add(labelsPanel,                    BorderLayout.SOUTH);
184
185        // --- Root layout: left attributes, center images, right controls ---
186        JPanel root = new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
187        root.add(attributesPanel.getComponent(), BorderLayout.WEST);
188        root.add(imagesWithNav,                  BorderLayout.CENTER);
189        root.add(controlsPanel.getComponent(),   BorderLayout.EAST);
190
191        // --- Bottom panel with import overrides checkbox + close button ---
192        JPanel    bottomPanel             = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(10, 10));
193        JCheckBox importOverridesCheckBox = new JCheckBox("Overrides");
194        bottomPanel.add(importOverridesCheckBox, BorderLayout.WEST);
195        JButton    closeButton            = new JButton("Close Viewer");
196        closeButton.addActionListener(e -> closeListener.onClose());
197
198        JPanel rightBox = new JPanel(new FlowLayout(FlowLayout.RIGHT, 10, 10));
199        rightBox.add(closeButton);
200        bottomPanel.add(rightBox, BorderLayout.EAST);
201
202        root.add(bottomPanel, BorderLayout.SOUTH);
203
204        // --- Return all components (ViewerFrame consumes LayoutComponents) ---
205        return new LayoutComponents(
206                root,
207                rightImageLabel,
208                experimentLabel,
209                recordingLabel,
210                leftGridPanel,
211                attributesPanel,
212                navigationPanel,
213                controlsPanel,
214                importOverridesCheckBox
215        );
216    }
217
218    /**
219     * Creates a bordered panel that forces a fixed square aspect ratio based on
220     * NUMBER_PIXELS_WIDTH and NUMBER_PIXELS_HEIGHT. Both the grid and right-image
221     * panels use this container.
222     */
223    private JPanel createSquareImagePanel(JComponent comp) {
224        JPanel panel = new JPanel(new BorderLayout()) {
225            public Dimension getPreferredSize() {
226                return new Dimension(NUMBER_PIXELS_WIDTH, NUMBER_PIXELS_HEIGHT);
227            }
228
229            public void setBounds(int x, int y, int w, int h) {
230                int size = Math.min(w, h);
231                super.setBounds(x, y, size, size);
232            }
233        };
234
235        panel.setBorder(BorderFactory.createLineBorder(Color.BLACK, 1));
236        panel.add(comp, BorderLayout.CENTER);
237        return panel;
238    }
239}
